records.deidentified_narrative: unit 1 entered the parking lot of drew's exxon located at 804 earl rudder freeway south in college station, brazos county, texas and attempted to park in a space near the building's front door. as unit 1 began turning into a parking space, she instead continued straight at an angle relative to the building and accelerated straight, causing her to strike a pedestrian before colliding with one of the building's brick pillars. the driver of unit 1 later explained that, as she was pulling into the parking space, her foot slipped off of the brake pedal and onto the accelerator, and that she accelerated rapidly forward before she could correct her mistake. the pedestrian which was struck was examined by csfd paramedics and refused treatment. the general manager of the station stated the damage estimate for the pillar which was struck was approximately $10,000. there was a detectable odor of alcohol at the scene, but the pedestrian who was struck stated the beer which was seen scattered about was his. sfst's were performed on the driver of unit 1, who performed satisfactorily and showed no signs of intoxication.
